description:
OG Health is a personalized concierge primary care practice founded by Dr. Oswaldo Grenardo, MD, MBA, MSHA, FAAFP. We specialize in delivering high-touch, patient-centered healthcare that focuses on the whole person — not just symptoms. Unlike traditional primary care, our concierge model allows for extended visits, direct 24/7 access to your physician, personalized preventive planning, and deeper continuity of care.

At OG Health, Dr. Grenardo brings extensive clinical experience and healthcare leadership to create a practice where patients feel heard, supported, and guided through every stage of their health journey. We take the time to understand each patient’s unique needs, coordinate care across specialists, and develop proactive plans that help patients live healthier, more empowered lives.

In short, OG Health partners with you to deliver thoughtful, relationship-based medicine that puts your well-being first.
